div.head: Leis Wl 4
div.ab: Cil ki prendra larrun senz siwte e senz cri, que cil en lest a ki il avera le damage fait, e il vienge aprés, si est resun qu'il duinse X sol. de hengwite, e si face la justise a la primere devise.

If a man captures a thief against whom no hue and cry has been raised by the injured man, who afterwards comes forward, then it is right that the latter should pay 10 shillings as a fine for neglecting to arrest the thief, and satisfy the law in this way at the first meeting of the Court.
